sources.distance: The 140 pc distance adopted by ALMA Partnership et al. (2015), Section 1, and Pinte et al. (2016), Section 1. The package uses the published radio position; Gaia astrometry is not used.
sources.radialVelocity: No heliocentric stellar radial velocity is supplied by this reconstruction. Zero is assumed for display propagation; the paper gives gas velocities in the LSR frame, which are not substituted for it (https://doi.org/10.3847/0004-637X/816/1/25)
